nodes.label: Caveman Tone
nodes.rationale: Drop articles, filler, and hedging so technical substance stays; code and commits stay normal prose.

nodes.label: Phase Gating
nodes.rationale: Phase complete only after MODERNIZATION_PLAN verification, recorded results, and merge to main. One unstacked branch per phase.

nodes.label: Feature Out of Scope
nodes.rationale: Local Streamlit plus LangGraph app only: no hosted multi-user auth, donations, unlocked provider lists, or unrestricted code execution.

nodes.label: advance() Stepper
nodes.rationale: Hand-written dispatcher over compiled invoke so UI can pause, inject, and huddle one member per rerun.

nodes.label: Compiled debate_graph
nodes.rationale: Same nodes as advance() but no pause. Live UI path is advance(), not debate_graph.invoke.

nodes.label: Keyword Retrieve
nodes.rationale: Term-count overlap over uploaded docs, not embeddings. Module docstring states this choice.

nodes.label: Restricted AST Math Tool
nodes.rationale: ast eval, not exec or a sandbox VM.

nodes.label: SQLite Decision Memory
nodes.rationale: Local file, not a server: decisions, decision_links, optional FTS5, full state_json upsert for resume.

nodes.label: No Authentication
nodes.rationale: Anyone who can reach the Streamlit port can use the session. Do not expose 8522 to the internet.

nodes.label: Not Here Constraints
nodes.rationale: No auth, no multi-user server, no unrestricted exec, no CLI that runs a debate.

nodes.label: Auto-Clarity
nodes.rationale: Drop caveman for security warnings, irreversible actions, or a confused user; resume after.

nodes.label: Manual CI Enforcement
nodes.rationale: Workflow already exists; requiring quality and hooks is a human GitHub Settings step. Until then CI does not block merges.

nodes.label: No Streamlit Launch Rule
nodes.rationale: Never launch Streamlit, frontend, or local app server. Verify with pytest, unit tests, and static checks only.

nodes.label: Modular Local Monolith
nodes.rationale: Presentation to orchestration to nodes to I/O in one process. UI never constructs a provider client. Package must not import Streamlit.

nodes.label: ADR: advance() Is the Contract
nodes.rationale: Two control planes exist. Seam tests pin advance() and next_action, not debate_graph.invoke, because compiled invoke loses pause and inject.

nodes.label: Leave-in-Place Stack
nodes.rationale: Already on target Python/uv/Ruff/ty/pytest/prek stack. Do not rewrite Streamlit, LangGraph, or SQLite. Residual L3 hardening only.

nodes.label: ADR: No Streamlit e2e
nodes.rationale: Session rule plus flake cost. Drop UI e2e; package tests only. Playwright not scheduled. UI stays L1.

nodes.label: Security Hard Rules
nodes.rationale: Never commit .env or local DBs. Do not add unrestricted exec/eval/shell. Do not weaken grounded-mode allow-list without design discussion.
